actions.candidate_compact_description: The bill would authorize a St. Louis VA bed tower and clinical expansion with associated administrative, utility and parking construction, capped at $1.762668 billion. It authorizes appropriations for fiscal2026 or the year funds are appropriated; it does not itself appropriate that amount or establish a completed facility or delivered care.
actions.candidate_exact_action_meaning: The exact unamended Senate-engrossed S2393 would permit the VA Secretary to carry out a fiscal2026 major medical-facility project in St. Louis: a new bed tower, clinical-building expansion, consolidated administrative building and warehouse, utility plant and parking garages. The maximum authorized project amount is $1,762,668,000. Section2(b) separately authorizes appropriations of that amount for fiscal2026 OR the year funds are appropriated to the Construction, Major Projects account. Neither clause is an actual appropriation or a completed construction/care delivery claim. The short title says Fiscal Year2025 while the operative project/appropriation clauses say fiscal2026; retain the printed distinction, not a silent title-based correction. Defined clinical infrastructure establishes proposed Health membership, within a mixed medical/admin/site project rather than wholly direct treatment spending. No general veteran benefit, patient admission rule, guaranteed construction schedule or medical outcome follows. The May20 House suspension-and-passage question passed405-5/20Not Voting. A Yea supported passing this exact authorization; a Nay opposed it. Not Voting is resolved nondirectional, not opposition. House passage is not enactment, obligation of funds, completed construction or delivered care.

claim_source_map.passage: [Congressional Bills 119th Congress] [From the U.S. Government Publishing Office] [S. 2393 Engrossed in Senate (ES)] <DOC> 119th CONGRESS 1st Session S. 2393 _______________________________________________________________________ AN ACT To authorize a major medical facility project for the Department of Veterans Affairs for fiscal year 2026 in St. Louis, Missouri, and for other purposes. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled, SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE. This Act may be cited as the ``Fiscal Year 2025 Veterans Affairs Major Medical Facility Authorization Act''. SEC. 2. AUTHORIZATION OF MAJOR MEDICAL FACILITY PROJECT OF DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026 IN ST. LOUIS, MISSOURI. (a) In General.--The Secretary of Veterans Affairs may carry out a major medical facility project in fiscal year 2026 in St. Louis, Missouri, that consists of the construction of a new bed tower, clinical building expansion, consolidated administrative building and warehouse, utility plant, and parking garages, in an amount not to exceed $1,762,668,000. (b) Authorization of Appropriations.--There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of Veterans Affairs for fiscal year 2026 or the year in which funds are appropriated for the Construction, Major Projects account, $1,762,668,000 for the project authorized in subsection (a). Passed the Senate December 17, 2025. Attest: Secretary. 119th CONGRESS 1st Session S. 2393 _______________________________________________________________________ AN ACT To authorize a major medical facility project for the Department of Veterans Affairs for fiscal year 2026 in St. Louis, Missouri, and for other purposes.
